races.name: Behind The Lens Media Handicap
races.verdict:
FOREVER GLAMOROUS should benefit from the return to 5f and can notch a second C&D win of the campaign. Little Jaybee still isn't long with her yard and is also shortlisted, with Bridget's Baby taken to complete the 1-2-3.

  1. FOREVER GLAMOROUS
  2. LITTLE JAYBEE
  3. BRIDGET'S BABY

races.name: Golwg Gwendraeth Handicap
races.verdict:
Top-weight BELLA BISBEE ran well when third at Doncaster last time and makes plenty of appeal having rather leniently been eased another 1 lb. The Stone Power has been progressive on the whole this season and is also considered alongside the consistent Dappled Light.

  1. BELLA BISBEE
  2. THE STONE POWER
  3. DAPPLED LIGHT

races.name: Dandara Homes Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
WITHTEARSINMYEYES's second to the smart prospect Seet at Wolverhampton is the best form on offer here and the drop to 7f was probably against her last time, so she's taken to get off the mark. Sydney Rock is highly respected after back-to-back placed efforts in handicaps, whilst the ex-French Graniteville should appreciate the return to 1m.

  1. WITHTEARSINMYEYES (IRE)
  2. SYDNEY ROCK
  3. GRANITEVILLE (IRE)

races.name: Thomas Arms Llanelli Classified Stakes
races.verdict:
This can be fought out by the pair of 3-y-os, with ALICE'S INFLUENCE shading preference over Castlekeely. Dinah Myte and Pebble Dash are others to keep an eye on.

  1. ALICE'S INFLUENCE
  2. CASTLEKEELY (IRE)
  3. DINAH MYTE

races.name: K P Tyres Handicap
races.verdict:
SUNSHINE AND ROSES has twice shaped well on the back of her breakthrough success at Wolverhampton in July, conceding first run when runner-up back at that venue 10 days ago. She remains on a workable mark and earns the vote provided this longer trip doesn't stretch her. Windsor scorer Give Me Sun rates a big danger however, with Grindleton another in the mix.

  1. SUNSHINE AND ROSES
  2. GIVE ME SUN
  3. GRINDLETON

races.name: Noah's Ark Christmas Party Race Day Handicap
races.verdict:
There's a lack of obvious pace but that may be no bad thing for CRACKERGEE who can quickly resume winning ways. Last-time-out winners Robusto and Flightofthephoenix may prove the biggest dangers, in that order.

  1. CRACKERGEE
  2. ROBUSTO (IRE)
  3. FLIGHTOFTHEPHOENIX (IRE)

races.name: Nationwide Concreting Ltd Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
BREAK POINT is well treated on his form for Olly Murphy this time last year and may resume winning ways under a good-value claimer. An easy lead could see Kom Tu Voudras do best of the rest, in a race where it's difficult to discount any.

  1. BREAK POINT
  2. KOM TU VOUDRAS (FR)
  3. MOTAZZEN (IRE)

races.name: KSR Lighting Juvenile Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
The pick of these on Flat form, SALKADAN finished third at Uttoxeter on hurdling debut and he can step forward from that outing to open his account in this sphere. A pair making their first starts over hurdles could be the main dangers, Rum Diamond making plenty of appeal on pedigree and feared most ahead of Grey Sands.

  1. SALKADAN
  2. RUM DIAMOND
  3. GREY SANDS (IRE)

races.name: Mercedes-Benz Of Chichester Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
DELGANY SECOND NOW cruised to victory on handicap bow at Stratford on Tuesday and may well defy a 7-lb penalty. Onehundredneighty and Khalk'eau Spigao are both potential improvers for very capable yards, with Kotari another likely player if putting it all together.

  1. DELGANY SECOND NOW
  2. ONEHUNDREDNEIGHTY (IRE)
  3. KHALK'EAU SPIGAO (FR)

races.name: KSR Lighting, The Ultimate Lighting Solutions Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
Preference is for OF CORSE I CAN, who has shown promise in his 2 starts this season and could be ready to return to winning ways having eased back down in the weights. Youdecide is much respected, though, after his successful return at Stratford on Tuesday, while Helios Allen is one to keep an eye on making his stable debut.

  1. OF CORSE I CAN (FR)
  2. YOUDECIDE (IRE)
  3. HELIOS ALLEN (FR)

races.name: Glorious Spa Company Mares' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Handicap debutant STEAL A GLANCE is bred to appreciate this significantly longer trip. She's fancied to go one better than at Stratford on Tuesday, with progressive mare Camshaft the obvious form danger. Mobile Mamma is an interesting first runner at Fontwell for an Irish yard that knows the time of day.

  1. STEAL A GLANCE
  2. CAMSHAFT (IRE)
  3. MOBILE MAMMA (IRE)

races.name: Southcoast Homecare Excellence In Care Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A mistake at the last at Stratford likely prevented PERSON OF INTEREST from making it back-to-back wins, but he is fancied to make amends with more still to offer for current yard. He gets the vote ahead of A Little Something, who is potentially well handicapped if her jumping holds up, with Merely A Detail also considered.

  1. PERSON OF INTEREST (IRE)
  2. A LITTLE SOMETHING
  3. MERELY A DETAIL

races.name: Nationwide Concreting Ltd Supporting Brockenhurst FC Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
In a open-looking finale, it could be worth taking a chance on interesting Irish raider DOUBLE POWER. Course winner Aggagio and once-useful Flat performer God Of Fire both look potentially well treated, along with Brave Guest, who has to enter calculations on the pick of his juvenile form.

  1. DOUBLE POWER (IRE)
  2. AGGAGIO (FR)
  3. GOD OF FIRE (IRE)

races.name: Virgin Bet / EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This can go the way of MOTOWN FILLY, who is taken to build on her debut promise at the second attempt having been tried at listed level last time. Cut And Sew finished behind 2 next-time-out winners on her latest outing and could be the main danger.

  1. MOTOWN FILLY (IRE)
  2. CUT AND SEW
  3. GOBBY GRACE (IRE)

races.name: White & Brooks Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
HAUTELUCE quickly resumed winning ways when making a successful handicap debut at Southwell and, with better still to come, she can land a third victory on just her fifth career start. Brighton Beach heads into handicaps on the back of a first win and is feared most, with Blue Noon also in the mix.

  1. HAUTELUCE (FR)
  2. BRIGHTON BEACH (IRE)
  3. BLUE NOON (IRE)

races.name: Virgin Bet A Good Bet Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
Preference is for AMMOONY who has shown improved form the last twice, beaten only by another progressive 3-y-o at Sandown last month. She can see off the challenge of a pair of handicap debutants, Kissmehoneyhoney the pick for second with Mother Dear completing the shortlist.

  1. AMMOONY (FR)
  2. KISSMEHONEYHONEY
  3. MOTHER DEAR

races.name: Virgin Bet Daily Extra Places Handicap
races.verdict:
Making her stable debut, RUBY'S PROFIT went with promise when third at Epsom a fortnight ago and she could be ready to take advantage of her reduced mark back at 5f. She can gain a second C&D success at the main expense of handicap debutant Velvet Goldmine, while Silver Wraith has dropped below her last winning mark.

  1. RUBY'S PROFIT (IRE)
  2. VELVET GOLDMINE (IRE)
  3. SILVER WRAITH

races.name: Virgin Bet Every Saturday Money Back Handicap
races.verdict:
VEIL OF CLOUDS proved a class apart and made a mockery of her mark at the second attempt at Lingfield 11 days ago. Wisely turned out under a penalty and sufficiently lightly raced to expect further progress, she makes plenty of appeal back on turf. Newsreader shaped well starting out for Tony Carroll at Ffos Las recently and along with Northcliff, heads the dangers.

  1. VEIL OF CLOUDS
  2. NEWSREADER (IRE)
  3. NORTHCLIFF (IRE)

races.name: Gay Kindersley Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
races.verdict:
KIMEKO GLORY settled better equipped with more severe headgear when running out an emphatic winner at Salisbury last week and can follow up a 5 lb penalty. Last year's winner Platinum Prince looks to have had this race in mind again and he's feared along with class-dropping Beach Point.

  1. KIMEKO GLORY
  2. PLATINUM PRINCE
  3. BEACH POINT (IRE)

races.name: Darlington RA & Ellie Wake Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This looks a match between DATSTHEHOLYALLOFIT and Genealogy, with preference just being for Patrick Neville's mare, who made a promising hurdling debut at Worcester last week and should prove even better suited by this longer trip.

  1. DATSTHEHOLYALLOFIT (IRE)
  2. GENEALOGY
  3. TRACKER ISSUE (IRE)

races.name: Newts Rocket To The Top Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
LITTLETOWN LAD wasn't as headstrong as he can be at Uttoxeter last time and a reproduction of that effort should be enough to score in a thin race. Yanka Blue is respected after back-to-back second-placed finishes, with Character Testing completing the 1-2-3.

  1. LITTLETOWN LAD (IRE)
  2. YANKA BLUE (IRE)
  3. CHARACTER TESTING

races.name: Bodhi Solutions Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
TOM CREEN shaped as if ready to strike when last seen here in April so he's taken to record a fifth C&D success. There are plenty of potential dangers, though, headed by Huit Reflets and Thank You Blue.

  1. TOM CREEN (IRE)
  2. HUIT REFLETS (FR)
  3. THANK YOU BLUE

races.name: Warm-Flo Hot To Trot Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
FINE POINT has largely been in excellent heart since joining Adam Nicol and can register a second win for the yard in a competitive affair. The hat-tricking seeking Saint Polo also ticks plenty of boxes, with Machete Beach also making appeal after going close at Uttoxeter.

  1. FINE POINT (IRE)
  2. SAINT POLO (FR)
  3. MACHETE BEACH

races.name: Bodhi Bespoke Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
JETEYE confirmed he's at least as good a chaser as he is a hurdler when making his third start over fences a winning one at Cartmel 6 weeks ago and he can defy a 1 lb nudge. Jo Arengeot Bey AA was beaten only by one who was gambled on at Uttoxeter last time and rates a clear next best.

  1. JETEYE (IRE)
  2. JO ARENGEOT BEY AA (FR)
  3. GETAWAY VIC (IRE)

races.name: MW Civils & Groundworks Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
WILLIAM YEATS should benefit from this step up in trip and he's an interesting proposition making his second handicap outing after a 5-month break. Pepite De Saphir showed enough last time to suggest she can prove competitive from this reduced mark and makes most appeal of the remainder.

  1. WILLIAM YEATS
  2. PEPITE DE SAPHIR
  3. TOP FLIGHT CENTURY (FR)

races.name: Bodhi Creative Mares' Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Jamie Snowden has an excellent record with newcomers in this type of event so REVERSE CHARGE is taken to make a winning start at the main expense of penalised winner You Be Lucky Jean.

  1. REVERSE CHARGE (IRE)
  2. YOU BE LUCKY JEAN
  3. MEGATOTHEMAX (IRE)

meeting_summary.going: Good-good to firm on round course

races.name: Killik Nursery
races.verdict:
ARABICA QUEEN, Sky Secret and Innichen all contested a strong Glorious Goodwood nursery last month, with Jonathan Portman's well-drawn charge fancied to come out on top this time.

  1. ARABICA QUEEN
  2. SKY SECRET
  3. INNICHEN (ITY)

races.name: Killik Handicap
races.verdict:
GOOD EARTH likes it here and may land the spoils back down in grade. Hint of Humour and Maharajas Express could fill the places if a strong pace materialises.

  1. GOOD EARTH (IRE)
  2. HINT OF HUMOUR
  3. MAHARAJAS EXPRESS

races.name: Chasemore Farm EBF Maiden Stakes
races.verdict:
THUNDER HOME is taken to gain compensation for his unfortunate near-miss over C&D last month. Cilician is a solid yardstick in this sort of event and should be thereabouts. Algaihabane and Nethersteam appeal as likely improvers, with John & Thady Gosden's Group 2-entered colt particularly feared.

  1. THUNDER HOME (IRE)
  2. CILICIAN (IRE)
  3. ALGAIHABANE

races.name: House Of Killik Handicap
races.verdict:
A competitive handicap can go the way of the class-dropping DRYMEE who should get a stronger pace here. Thursday Girl has an eye-catching jockey booking but may have to settle for second again, with handicap debutant Dovecote seeing out the places.

  1. DRYMEE
  2. THURSDAY GIRL
  3. DOVECOTE

races.name: Killik Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
KINO PLASMAT can make a winning start in handicaps for a yard that do well with such types. Good cases can be made for several others, with Dark Rosa and Box Clever heading the list of dangers.

  1. KINO PLASMAT (IRE)
  2. DARK ROSA (IRE)
  3. BOX CLEVER

races.name: Killik Family Handicap
races.verdict:
SOVEREIGN VIEW represents a yard going well and can get off the mark for the year at the expense of the class-dropping Galyx. Sharp Move and Oh Yes You Do are also ones to consider.

  1. SOVEREIGN VIEW
  2. GALYX (IRE)
  3. SHARP MOVE (IRE)

races.name: AJA Novice Flat Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
races.verdict:
It might be worth taking a chance that DEEP SLEEP is yet another that James Owen works his magic on. This 3-y-o is much less exposed than most of today's opposition and confidence in his chance would increase should the betting vibes be strong. Fellow 3-y-os Jungle Knight, Hatamoto and Harswell River head the dangers.

  1. DEEP SLEEP
  2. JUNGLE KNIGHT
  3. HATAMOTO

races.name: Work Matters Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
WOOTZ looked good on his Ffos Las debut and this looks an excellent chance for him to follow up. Charlie Johnston newcomer Walk In Provence may prove to be the one to chase Roger Varian's charge home.

  1. WOOTZ (IRE)
  2. WALK IN PROVENCE (IRE)
  3. RUA MOR (IRE)

races.name: Caddick Construction EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A big field but it's unlikely too many count. BAARBERINI had Astral Crown 2½ lengths behind in third when second over this trip at Southwell last time and is taken to confirm that superiority over David O'Meara's charge and make it third time lucky. Mr Minz and Quintillion, who should be wiser with his Beverley debut behind him, are others who could have a say.

  1. BAARBERINI
  2. ASTRAL CROWN (IRE)
  3. MR MINZ (IRE)

races.name: Ivegate Building Handicap
races.verdict:
A useful sprint. ANYASI had Monday's Musselburgh handicap winner Two Commanders behind in second when comfortably defying a penalty at Leicester last time and even an opening mark of 90 could underestimate this exciting colt. Veblen Good is shaping up to be one of those reliable David O'Meara handicappers and gets the nod for the forecast spot with Conor Whiteley taking a handy 5 lb off. Art Lover, another unexposed 3-y-o, is next on the list ahead of Durham Castle.

  1. ANYASI
  2. VEBLEN GOOD (IRE)
  3. ART LOVER (IRE)

races.name: Frameclad Handicap
races.verdict:
Another useful contest. MIRSKY led for a long way in a strong 1m York handicap last week and is worth chancing having dropped to 1 lb below the mark he defied in the Thirsk Hunt Cup in the spring. Bobby Bennu, Northern Express and Perfect Part are a few of many others to consider, while it'll be very interesting to see how strong the betting vibes are surrounding twice-raced Karl Burke handicap newcomer Majestic Dane.

  1. MIRSKY
  2. BOBBY BENNU (IRE)
  3. NORTHERN EXPRESS (IRE)

races.name: Applebridge Group Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
PINATIQUE is given a chance to build on a solid comeback run for new trainer Sir Mark Prescott at Newbury a fortnight ago. Sudu is surely better than he showed when strong in the betting for his course reappearance earlier in the month and is second choice ahead of Arrange.

  1. PINATIQUE (FR)
  2. SUDU
  3. ARRANGE (IRE)

races.name: Coca-Cola HBC Ireland And Northern Ireland 3-Y-O Hurdle
races.verdict:
NICKY LARSON came clear in impressive fashion at Ballinrobe 3 weeks ago and can defy a penalty with more improvement on the way. Old rivals No Bother Aoife and Nod of Approval can chase him home again.

  1. NICKY LARSON (FR)
  2. NO BOTHER AOIFE (IRE)
  3. NOD OF APPROVAL (IRE)

races.name: Dale Farm Dromona Mares Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
This could be a good opening for COSMIC FRONT on her debut for Willie Mullins. She reached a fairly useful level on the Flat in France and starts out over hurdles in an ordinary race. Jo's Secret and Rare Times are the clear picks of those with experience in this sphere.

  1. COSMIC FRONT
  2. JO'S SECRET (IRE)
  3. RARE TIMES (IRE)

races.name: Golden Cow Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Several hold claims but the class-dropping LIPS FREEDOM is worth a chance to bounce back. Hopeful Hero had excuses at Galway last time and can resume his progress ahead of Bruant in the run for the places.

  1. LIPS FREEDOM (GER)
  2. HOPEFUL HERO (IRE)
  3. BRUANT

races.name: Pepsico (Walkers Snacks) Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
A very ordinary maiden hurdle and another chance is given to WACKESTONE up in trip. He hasn't been progressing but clearly has the ability to win a race like this judged on his 2 placed efforts in juvenile events last season and goes in stronger headgear now. Santa Domingo is the clear danger on his hurdles debut.

  1. WACKESTONE (IRE)
  2. SANTA DOMINGO (IRE)
  3. HIDDEN EMPIRE (FR)

races.name: Denny Hurdle
races.verdict:
Hopefully first-time cheekpieces have the desired effect for ROCKY'S DIAMOND, who has the strongest form on offer. He's the pick ahead of Reverend Hubert and Samui. If there's a significant improver in the field, it's probably Clay Pigeons.

  1. ROCKY'S DIAMOND (IRE)
  2. REVEREND HUBERT (IRE)
  3. SAMUI

races.name: Tayto Group Limited Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
KNOCKNAGORAN LADY shaped as if still ahead of her mark at Roscommon last time and could be the answer in a fiendishly difficult handicap. Sneddy Eddie heads the dangers, along with last year's runner-up Schiehallion. Charlie's Dilemma and Astley are also potentially well treated.

  1. KNOCKNAGORAN LADY (IRE)
  2. SNEDDY EDDIE (IRE)
  3. SCHIEHALLION (IRE)

races.name: Hovis Ireland Mares Flat Race
races.verdict:
HILLY FILLY looked a good prospect when staying on well from a poor position at Cork 7 weeks ago and can defy a penalty with improvement on the way. Clovelly Charm has more on her plate but can't be dismissed, while Hutton Star looks the pick of the newcomers on paper.

  1. HILLY FILLY (IRE)
  2. CLOVELLY CHARM (IRE)
  3. HUTTON STAR (IRE)

races.name: Adare Manor Opportunity Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
GAME POINT has made a bright start over hurdles and this looks a good opportunity for him to open his account. Faerie Tales made more impact than her uninspiring Flat record suggested she might when third on her hurdles debut at Tramore a fortnight ago and could improve. Newcomer Down After Dark is also worth a look.

  1. GAME POINT (IRE)
  2. FAERIE TALES (IRE)
  3. DOWN AFTER DARK (IRE)

races.name: Visitwexford.ie Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
ROOM FOR ONE MORE took a big step forward when runner-up at Tramore on her latest outing, pulling clear of the rest, and she can build on that effort as she goes handicapping. She gets the vote ahead of Game Phoenix, who showed improved form on her handicap debut last time, with Cool Summer also considered.

  1. ROOM FOR ONE MORE (IRE)
  2. GAME PHOENIX (IRE)
  3. COOL SUMMER (IRE)

races.name: Treo Eile Handicap Hurdle (0-100) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
Handicap newcomer MAHLER'S BEST will be suited by this longer trip and she can build on a promising yard debut. Tedworth likely remains on a workable mark and is also shortlisted, whilst Tomas O Maille offered more than he has done for a while at Sligo last week.

  1. MAHLER'S BEST (IRE)
  2. TEDWORTH (IRE)
  3. TOMAS O MAILLE (IRE)

races.name: Treo Eile Handicap Hurdle (0-100) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
CHOSEN PRINCESS can step forward again from her encouraging handicap debut and get off the mark in what looks the stronger of the divisions to this handicap. Sekakarma and The Ducks Walk also hold solid claims.

  1. CHOSEN PRINCESS (IRE)
  2. SEKAKARMA (IRE)
  3. THE DUCKS WALK (IRE)

races.name: Traynors Of Wexford Mares Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
CLODY DIAMOND was better than the result on her course chase debut in June and Paul Nolan's mare may prove the answer now back hurdling. Lakewood Rose will be a threat if back to the form she showed when third in a Punchestown handicap at the start of the summer. Something Fabulous may build on her recent Tramore hurdle debut third and is next on the list.

  1. CLODY DIAMOND (IRE)
  2. LAKEWOOD ROSE (IRE)
  3. SOMETHING FABULOUS (IRE)

races.name: Brendan Cullimore Electrical Rated Novice Chase
races.verdict:
LE COQ HARDI can provide Henry de Bromhead with a third win in this race since 2019. Femme Magnifique is thriving for her new yard and is the obvious danger.

  1. LE COQ HARDI (IRE)
  2. FEMME MAGNIFIQUE (IRE)
  3. WARRIORS WOOD

races.name: Dan & Breda Byrne Memorial Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
KASPER HAUSER made it back-to-back wins when successful on chasing debut at Tramore last time, scoring in good style, and with his 4-y-o allowance he can go on to land the hat-trick. Luimneach could be the main danger with more still to offer for current yard, ahead of Chosen Shant who has won 3 times at this venue.

  1. KASPER HAUSER
  2. LUIMNEACH (IRE)
  3. CHOSEN SHANT (IRE)

races.name: Racing Again October 25th & 26th Handicap Chase (0-100)
races.verdict:
THEWAYBACKHOME made an eye-catching debut over fences at Tramore 2 weeks ago could be worth chancing up against mostly exposed sorts. Previous winners of this race Hit The Frame and North Of Nashville head the dangers.

  1. THEWAYBACKHOME (IRE)
  2. HIT THE FRAME
  3. NORTH OF NASHVILLE (IRE)
